transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before we get into the details on the Midnight Arcade delivery package, I want to walk through our package-lock routine so we're all on the same page. I need signoff from rights, post-production, and publicity — each of you flagging any required changes — before I give final approval. Let's start there. Does anyone have any issues with the current draft package as it stands?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I reviewed the countersigned music license this morning, and there are two issues with the current draft package. First, the license restricts distribution to the United States and Canada only — but the draft package currently lists worldwide delivery. Second, the required credit is exactly 'Music licensed courtesy of Northline Songs,' which does not match the studio's standard music credit currently listed in the package. I haven't entered the countersigned terms into the delivery tracker yet because the rights database migration is still open, but these changes need to be reflected before Mara approves.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a post-production issue. I received the broadcaster's completed ingest test today, and it confirms that delivery must be an IMF package at 25 fps with English SDH captions. The current draft package lists a 4K UHD 24 fps master and ordinary English subtitles, which will fail the partner's ingest specification. I've kept the test result in the post-production test folder pending this routine package-lock meeting, but these changes need to be reflected before Mara approves.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a publicity issue. I confirmed with the artist's representative this afternoon that publicity for the special is embargoed until June 21, and the representative will reject any public release dated earlier than June 21. The current draft package lists a June 14 publicity release, which conflicts with the embargo. The approval email is currently attached to the publicity calendar rather than the delivery tracker, but this change needs to be reflected before Mara approves.
transcript.speaker: A4
